Next: metais render <package> --out <dir>
      Renders into a new directory; or remove, from the existing one, what
      stands at the path the finding names.
  output.destination.case_variant
  output.destination.link
  output.destination.not_directory
  output.destination.not_regular_file

Next: metais render <package> --out <dir>
      Renders into a directory that does not exist yet, which metais creates.
  output.destination.commit_failed
  output.destination.nothing_written
  output.destination.staging_exists

Next: metais render <package> --out <dir> --overwrite
      Replaces the files the render writes in the directory, and leaves every
      other file in it alone.
  output.destination.not_empty
  usage.flag_excluded

Next: metais schema <package> <name> --fields
      Lists the fields of the input named in the finding, one line each with its
      constraints; add an examples value they allow to the field named, in the
      schema file the finding locates, and the generator uses it.
  schema.sample_invalid
  schema.sample_unsatisfiable

Next: metais render <package> --out - --only <path>
      Writes one file's bytes, which may go to a terminal; or redirect standard
      output to a file for the archive.
  usage.archive_to_terminal

Next: metais render --help
      Prints the operands and flags metais render takes.
  usage.bad_value
  usage.missing_operand
  usage.package_from_stdin
  usage.repeated_flag
  usage.unexpected_operand
  usage.unknown_flag

Next: metais render <package> --out <dir> --now 2026-01-31T09:00:00Z
      Gives the render time as an RFC 3339 date-time with an offset.
  usage.bad_value

Next: metais help inputs
      Explains how inputs are supplied: the data directory, --inputs-json, --set
      and --set-json.
  usage.conflicting_flags

Next: metais render <package> --data <dir> --out <dir>
      Names a data directory that exists and can be read.
  usage.data_dir_unreadable

Next: metais render <package> --sample --out <dir>
      Renders from sample data in place of a data directory; --optional, --seed
      and --items tune the generator.
  usage.flag_excluded
  usage.flag_requires

Next: metais render <package> --out <dir>
      Names the directory to render into: a new one, or an empty one;
      --overwrite renders into one that holds entries.
  usage.missing_flag

Next: metais render <package> --out <dir> --dry-run
      Lists every file the render writes, by the path --only takes, and writes
      nothing.
  usage.unknown_output
